about_short_description.short_description: AlemHealth provides telemedicine and digital health solutions designed and optimised for frontier markets.

product.name: AlemHealth RIS/PACS Platform
product.description: A cloud-based radiology information and picture archiving system for storing, sharing, viewing, and reporting medical imaging studies.

product.name: AlemBox DICOM Gateway
product.description: A hardware device that facilitates high-volume, automated uploading of medical images from imaging equipment to the cloud.

product.name: AlemHub Enterprise Reporting Server
product.description: An on-premises hardware server that supports simultaneous radiologist reporting and remote collaboration with integrated DICOM viewing and HL7 connectivity.

product.name: AlemHealth Connect Radiology Reporting Suite
product.description: A software suite for managing, viewing, and reporting on medical images with AI-powered report generation and quality control.

product.name: AlemHealth FrontDesk RIS
product.description: A radiology information system module for patient scheduling, workflow management, and integration with modality worklists and HL7 systems.

product.name: AlemHealth Connect Desktop Uploader
product.description: A desktop application for uploading medical images to the AlemHealth cloud platform, ensuring easy access and integration.
